Method of Attack: Emulating patient vitals by reverse engineering a weak communications protocol (Rwhat) used by medical equipment to send data to central monitoring systems
Physical access attack by disconnecting patient monitoring client and replacing it with a device sending falsified data
Network attack via ARP spoofing on the same network to intercept and modify data in real-time
Spoofing unencrypted UDP packets between patient monitors and central stations
Impacted Systems: Medical patient monitoring equipment and central monitoring stations using the Rwhat protocol
Attack Vector: Physical access to patient monitoring client
Network access on the same network as patient monitoring client for ARP spoofing
